input.quote: This Agreement shall renew automatically thereafter for successive one year periods until terminated pursuant to Section 12 herein or unless either Client or TrueLink deliver to the other written notice of intent not to renew no later than thirty (30) days prior to the end of said year.
input.rationale: Renewal sits in the term clause (Section 13, p0078): after the initial 1-year term the Agreement renews automatically for successive one-year periods, and either party (including Client) may stop renewal by written notice 30 days before the end of the then-current year. Each renewal term is 12 months (no multi-year renewal, so no walk-away exposure) and Client's non-renewal notice window is 30 days, satisfying both the fallback ceiling of 60 days and the preferred 30-day opt-out. On price, renewal permits no unilateral uplift: fees are fixed by the schedules in Exhibits A and B (p0045), Section 6 freezes Hosting Services costs for the first year and adds an MFN that rates will not exceed those charged to any other party (p0047), and Section 16 requires any amendment to be in writing and signed by the party to be charged, so any increase at renewal needs Client's agreement and the conditional price-cap element is not triggered. The only shortfall against preferred is the absence of a Vendor reminder 60 days before renewal; that is a minor sub-element we note rather than redline. The clause meets the fallback (and most of preferred) on its material terms and needs no change.
